( n. ) [ BHS id.; cf S. brāhmaṇa, n. ], the state of a true brahman; Th 631 (etena brāhmaṇo hoti etaṃ ~aṃ uttamaṃ; Th-a II 265, 25 : ~an ti vā brahmaññaṃ āha, evaṃ uttamaṃ brahmaññaṃ na jaccādīhi adhippāyo, Be so; Se na jaccādī ti; Ce, Ee ~an ti brahmaññu āha; Ce na jaccādinā ti; Ee na jaccādī ti); — °’- ajjhoharaṇa , n. , the swallowing of a brahman; Ja VI 213, 13* (ye keci kūpā idha jīvaloke loṇūdakā kūpakhaṇehi khātā na ~ena tesu āpo apeyyo); — °- kaññā , f. , the daughter of a brahman; a brahman girl; D I 97, 6 (khattiyakumāro ~āya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya); A II 205, 11 (santi … imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññā pi ~ā pi gahapatikaññā pi); Sv 267, 12 ; — °- kulīna , mfn. , from a brahman family; D III 81, 1 (°-jaccā ~ā); — °- gahapatikā , m.pl. , brahmans and tradesmen and farmers; ( sometimes perhaps brahman householders ?) Vin II 139, 2 ; Ud 4, 4 (~o bhikkhu); Ja II 84, 2* (so ’haṃ ~o); Sp 111, 21 (bho ti ~ānaṃ jātisamudāgataṃ ālapanamattaṃ); 583, 6 (°-jātiyaṃ amaccaṃ); 1364, 10 (khattiyajātiyo tvaṃ °-jātiyo ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee brahmajātiyo ti); Ud-a 194, 11 (~-ttā); — °- pādasika , °-pārasaka, °-pārisaka, m. , a brahman mixed class; Ps III 410, 19 (khattiyakumārassa hi brāhmaṇakaññāya uppanno khattiyapādasiko nāma itaro ~o nāma, ete hīnajātimāṇavakā, Be, Se so; Ce °-pārasako; Ee °-pārisiko; Ce, Ee etehi na jātimāṇavakā); — °- bhatta , m. , (one) who is devoted to, is a supporter of, brahmans; Sp 44, 8 (Bindusāro ~o ahosi, so brāhmaṇānaṃ ca brāhmaṇajātiyapāsaṇḍānaṃ ca … niccabhattaṃ paṭṭhapesi); Ps III 78, 16 (so pi ~o ahosi, gehe asītibrāhmaṇasahassāni niccabhattaṃ bhuñjanti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-bhato); 444, 22 (~o, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-bhaṭo; Ps-ṭ [ Be ] III 205, 13 : so kira bahū brāhmaṇe dhanaṃ datvā yaññaṃ kāresi); — °- mahāsāla , m. , a wealthy brahman; D II 146, 17 (Sv 586, 30 : ~ā nāma yesaṃ asītikoṭidhanaṃ nihitaṃ hoti, divasaparibbayo eko kahāpaṇakumbho nigacchati sāyaṃ ekaṃ sakaṭaṃ pavisati, Be, Ce so; Ee kahāpaṇatumbo; Se kahāpaṇakumbhaṃ); S I 71, 11 ; Sn p. 50, 14 ; Ja V 312, 21 (aññataro asītikoṭivibhavo ~o aputtako ahosi); — °- laddhika , mfn. , sharing the beliefs of the brahmans; Ps III 319, 17 (so kira rājā ~o); 451, 12 ; — °- vācanaka , °-vācaka, n. [ cf S. brāhmaṇavācana], an event at which brahmans recite and are fed; Ja I 318, 11 (ekaṃ kulaṃ sve ~aṃ karissāmī ti ācariyaṃ nimantayiṃsu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-vācakaṃ); IV 64, 19 (anto eko brāhmaṇo nisinno ~aṃ maññe bhavissati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-vācakaṃ); V 247, 16 (ekacce manussā ~aṃ karissāmā ti pāyāsaṃ paṭiyādetvā āsanāni paññāpetvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-vācakaṃ); Dhp-a II 84, 16 (ekasmiṃ ~e … pāyāsapātiṃ labhitvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-vācake); — °- vāṭaka , m. , an enclosure or garden for brahmans; Dhp-a IV 177, 17 (~aṃ gantvā ekaṃ mahallakabrāhmaṇaṃ ānehī ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-vādakaṃ); — abrāhmaṇa , m. , one who is not a brahman; one who is not a true brahman; D III 81, 13 (brāhmaṇā va sujjhanti no ~ā); M I 177, 22 (mayaṃ hi pubbe assamaṇā va samānā samaṇā ’mhā ti paṭijānimhā ~ā va samānā brāhmaṇā ’mhā ti paṭijānimhā); Sn 457 (brāhmaṇo ce tvaṃ brūsi maṃ ca brūsi ~aṃ); 650 (na jaccā hoti ~o … kammanā hoti ~o); Ja IV 388, 5 (atha te brāhmaṇā imehi caṇḍālucchiṭṭhakaṃ pītan ti ~e kariṃsu); VI 208, 4* (nābrāhmaṇo mantapadāni sikkhe); 211, 16* (tevijjasaṅghā ca puthū yajeyyuṃ ~aṃ kañci na yājayeyyuṃ, Be so; Ce, Se na brāhmaṇā kañci taṃ yājayeyyuṃ; Ee na brāhmaṇaṃ kañci taṃ yājayeyyuṃ; 215, 3´ : aññaṃ ~aṃ na yājeyyuṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee aññaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ na yājeyyuṃ); — atibrāhmaṇa , m. , a brahman surpassing other brahmans; Mil 277, 13 (brāhmanānaṃ ~o bhaveyya); Sp 739, 20 (aticaṇḍālo si ~o si).

ဗြာဟ္မဏဝဂ်၊ ဘုရားထံရောက်လာသော ပုဏ္ဏားတို့အား။ （မေးမြန်းသည့် ပြဿနာအားလျော်စွာ） ဖြေဆို-ဟောကြား-ရာစကားစု-အကြောင်းဝတ္ထု။
